questions.q: What should replace external yardsticks like money and followers?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says to forget outside measures and ask what matters to you.

questions.q: Why does Jarvis call specific long-term goals futile?
a: You cannot control outcomes, only today's work
Goals take too long to write down
Goals only work for large companies
questions.why: Lesson 2 says the future is unpredictable, but present work is yours to control.

questions.q: What price does meaningful creative work demand?
a: Working longer hours at a job
questions.why: Lesson 2 says you must swap consumption for creation.

questions.q: What does the summary say about where ideas come from?
a: Mixing others' work with your own values
questions.why: Lesson 3 says every idea builds on accumulated experience.

questions.q: What does the clay metaphor illustrate?
a: Shaping borrowed ideas until they tell your story
Keeping your first draft exactly as written
Selling work before it is finished
questions.why: Lesson 3 compares an idea to clay you shape to fit your values.
